name: Baruch's Coffee Roastery
address: 6 Via Appie, Die Voor Bay, Mossel Bay, 6506, South Africa
description_short: Local coffee roastery serving freshly roasted beans, artisan sandwiches, and wholesome breakfasts in Die Voor Bay.
description_long:
Baruch's Coffee Roastery has become a Mossel Bay institution for coffee lovers who appreciate the real thing. Located in Die Voor Bay, this welcoming spot roasts their own beans on-site, filling the space with that unmistakable aroma of freshly roasted coffee. The menu goes beyond excellent coffee, offering hearty breakfasts, creative sandwiches, and light meals that pair perfectly with their specialty brews.

The atmosphere is relaxed and unpretentious, attracting everyone from early-morning locals grabbing their daily fix to visitors seeking a proper caffeine stop along the Garden Route. You can watch the roasting process, pick up beans to take home, or simply settle in with a cappuccino and one of their popular sandwiches. With over 1,200 Google reviews and a solid 4.6-star rating, Baruch's has clearly struck the right chord with both the coffee-obsessed and those just looking for a quality breakfast spot in Mossel Bay.
